t: Makita 18V 5.0Ah Li-Ion LXT battery delivers reliable and long-lasting power for Makita cordless tools. Provides consistent output and extended run time, making it suitable for demanding construction sites and prolonged trade tasks such as electrical installations or roofing. Integrated battery protection circuitry guards against overloading, over-discharging, and over-heating, ensuring durability. A 4-stage LCD charge indicator allows quick battery charge assessment, while an impact-resistant outer case and shock-absorbing inner-liner provide robust protection. The battery operates effectively in extreme temperatures from -4°F to -20°C. Compatible with Makita LXT products, including the 36V (twin 18V) range.
b: Suitable For Use With All Makita LXT Cordless Tools
Integrated Battery Protection Circuit For Safety
